name: Blank Street

sectionInfo.Ingredients: An ingredient on its own, not a drink. In this guide every drink made with dairy milk is marked 'may contain oat (gluten)', and the oat version contains oat.

tips: Milk drinks: every drink made with dairy milk is marked 'may contain oat (gluten)', and the oat version contains oat. So they're all on the Avoid list.
Black is the way: Americano, espresso, black cold brew, plain teas, matcha tea and the iced lemon or peach teas have no gluten ingredients and no 'may contain' gluten.
Pastries: every pastry in every city contains wheat.
gaps: Blank Street doesn't call anything gluten free. The guide has no general allergen statement, only a 'May Contain' line for each item.
The guide has no date. The app uses the season in its file name and the date the PDF was made.
Coconut drink is listed as an ingredient, but no drink is listed with it, so the guide doesn't say whether a coconut milk drink may contain oat.
